verdict.rationale: Thoropass's MCP server docs indicate the AI assistant works 'within limits you set' and that admins can 'add or remove' certain capabilities to control what the agent can do, implying some configurable, least-privilege-style access for agents. However, there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped API keys/tokens or credential-level permissioning (e.g., OAuth scopes, per-agent API keys) — the evidence only describes tool-level enable/disable options within the MCP integration. missing for 10: explicit API credential/token scoping mechanism, documentation of credential issuance/revocation, and any audit trail for agent-specific access.
